# Gaps (generated)

Generated by `npm run verify` from the rule ledger and the verdict. The hand-written
account of divergences is `GAPS.md`.

- PRO-01: failing, 1019 of 1026 fixtures pass. Changing a subscription item credits the unused time of the old item as a negative line: minus the old unit amount times the old quantity times remaining time over period length. The credit carries the discount in force on the credited period, a used once coupon included.
- PRO-02: failing, 1018 of 1021 fixtures pass. It charges the remaining time on the new item as a positive line: new unit amount times new quantity times remaining time over period length.
- PRO-04: failing, 1027 of 1028 fixtures pass. Rounding of a prorated amount exactly at half a cent differs by mode: credits round away from zero; a classic charge of 5555555.5 is charged 5555555 (dev-brk-big-half-charge-classic), not rounded half up.
- PRO-05: failing, 988 of 989 fixtures pass. Without an immediate invoice, the preview is the next renewal invoice: prorations plus the next full period at the new price and quantity.
- PRO-07: failing, 175 of 179 fixtures pass. proration_behavior=always_invoice previews an immediate invoice holding only the proration lines.
- PRO-08: failing, 482 of 486 fixtures pass. A quantity change prorates like a price change: credit at the old quantity, charge at the new quantity.
- PER-01: failing, 196 of 197 fixtures pass. A monthly period runs to the same day of the next calendar month, so the period length in seconds depends on the month.
- DSC-01: failing, 488 of 489 fixtures pass. A percent-off coupon takes round(percent × sum) from the discountable lines it applies to and spreads it across them by a running rounded-down total: each line gets floor(running share) minus what earlier lines already got. This includes the first invoice, whose allocation sets the discount a flexible credit carries (wide3-256 for four lines).
- DSC-02: failing, 458 of 460 fixtures pass. In flexible billing mode, the discount is applied inside proration lines (proration_discounts=included) instead of at invoice level.
- MOD-01: failing, 396 of 398 fixtures pass. Classic and flexible modes differ by the order of prorating and discounting (DSC-02, DSC-04), which can move a line by one cent, by the credit line's discount list for a used once coupon, and by the cycle reset on an interval change in classic mode, and by the remaining-time line of a new item billed at 0 (PRO-11).

- DSC-07: failing, 117 of 118 fixtures pass. Flexible mode, immediate invoice: proration lines list their discounts at 0. The credit line lists nothing when the invoice has no discount. Otherwise it lists the surviving carried discounts still on the invoice, in subscription order.
